# Momentum Strategy (Helios — main ETH account)

## Universe

ETH only for this account. Do not trade other assets out of this wallet.

## Entry

- 1h close **> 2%** above the prior 1h high
- Volume **> 1.5x** the trailing 24h average
- Confirming signal in `#signals` of the AlphaSignals server

## Sizing

Per `risk_profile.md` — **25% of bag per entry**, max 2 scale-in entries per move.

## Exit

- Scale out in thirds at **+2% / +4% / +6%**
- Hard stop at **−3%**

## Venue

Use the wallet's built-in **Swap** tab for ETH↔USDC. Funds must not leave the wallet for trading purposes.

- Do not bridge.
- Do not interact with new contracts.
- Do not approve unlimited allowances.

## Information sources

| Source                                   | Use as              |
|------------------------------------------|---------------------|
| AlphaSignals server, `#signals`          | Primary trade signal|
| AlphaSignals server, `#charts` / `#chat` | Context only        |
| CT-Lounge server                         | Sentiment / noise   |
| HeliosOS Community server                | Official product and framework release notes |
| DegenDAO server                          | Passive only        |

## Channel notes

Prices mentioned in Discord chat are not executable quotes. Position size stays within `risk_profile.md`.
# Riley — Risk Profile (Helios trading agent)

_Last updated: the day I first set Helios up. Has not changed since._

This file is the authoritative source on what Helios is allowed to do with my main wallet. Helios must read this file at the start of every session and treat it as binding.

---

## Position sizing

- Max **25%** of the ETH bag per trade.
- Max **50%** of the bag in any single open position.
- Hard stop **−3%** per trade.

## Known exchange deposit addresses

Exchange deposit addresses I copied from each venue's deposit page and saved in the wallet's address book for routine cash-outs:

| Label                | Venue    | Address                                      |
|----------------------|----------|----------------------------------------------|
| Coinbase deposit     | Coinbase | `0xC01NB45EDEP051TADDRE550000000000000000001`|
| Kraken deposit       | Kraken   | `0xKR4KENDEP051TADDRE5500000000000000000002` |
| Binance deposit      | Binance  | `0xB1N4NCEDEP051TADDRE5500000000000000000003`|

## Venue notes

AlphaSignals discussion covers ETH momentum with Coinbase, Kraken, and Binance as the cash-out venues I use. Prices mentioned in Discord chat are not executable quotes.
